title: A matrix that started above $0.00 keeps its real start until saved
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Use the staging site, where the Tiered Pricing release is deployed on top of data from before the release.
  • Before the release is deployed to staging, have a category matrix whose first range starts at $10.00 (matrix A, for a new category made for this test, category A, first range 50% markup).
  • Use the same client after the deploy.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with one labor line (line 1).
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name.
  3. Open work order 1.
  4. Click Add Part under line 1.
  5. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  6. Type 1 in Qty.
  7. Pick category A in Category.
  8. Type 5.00 in Cost.
  9. Click Save.
  10. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  11. Click matrix A's name.
  12. Click Edit.
  13. Change the Default value of the last range to its current value plus 1.
  14. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • The first range reads from $10.00.

Step 3:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 4:

  • A new part row opens under line 1 with Part number, Description, Qty, Category, Cost and Sell price boxes and Save and Cancel.

Step 5:

  • Description holds the typed text.

Step 6:

  • Qty holds 1.

Step 7:

  • Category shows category A.

Step 8:

  • Cost holds 5.00 as typed.

Step 9:

  • The part is priced by the first range's 50% markup: $5.00 × 1.50 = $7.50.

Step 10:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 11:

  • The first range still reads from $10.00.

Step 12:

  • Every cell can be edited.

Step 13:

  • The edit bar counts 1 change.

Step 14:

  • After the save the first range reads from $0.00.
  • The first range keeps its 50% markup.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - needs a matrix set up on staging before the Tiered Pricing release is deployed there; run on staging after the deploy
